summary: vmware.vmware_rest no longer depends on cloud.common and disables turbo mode by default, with an environment variable to enable it.
questions: Is cloud.common still installed with vmware.vmware_rest?
How do I enable turbo mode in vmware_rest?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest drops cloud.common, turbo off
answer_card.answer_md:
- `cloud.common` is no longer a dependency and is not installed automatically.
- **Turbo mode** is disabled by default for module execution; it can be enabled with an environment variable.
